# mycellios

> mycellios is an open-source project developing a local-first distributed AI inference runtime.

The coordinator plans model stages across worker computers. The project is under active development; check the public evidence page before describing performance or production readiness. Multi-host GPU performance and combined-memory model execution are not established as general production capabilities.

The public network page reports a live snapshot when data is available. Compute contributions are voluntary; rewards are not live or promised.

## Product

- [Project overview](https://www.mycellios.com/): What mycellios is building and current capability limits.
- [Public network](https://www.mycellios.com/network): Public worker, model, and activity snapshot when available.
- [Create Studio](https://www.mycellios.com/create): Draft and preview an AI identity before publishing.
- [Contribute compute](https://www.mycellios.com/earn): Learn about voluntary browser and native test-network participation.
- [Downloads](https://www.mycellios.com/downloads): Check current native package availability.
- [Browser worker](https://www.mycellios.com/browser/): Try the browser-based worker where supported.
